version: MSB v4 · UNIFY v4 · MAT v2 (부드러운 그래픽 디자인 · 선명한 선) · 지형 구조 v4 (구역별 지형 + 구역 이음, 3단 가장자리) · 배경 v6.2 실내형 · 4방향 이어짐 (구획 뒷벽 + 세로 뒷벽 + 공용 조각 + 방 대표 조각 · 붙는 곳) · 미드키 게임 그림체

blocks.MSB: stylized 2D side-scrolling game art with a soft graphic design look, looks like a screen from a polished indie metroidvania game, set inside a sketchbook world, clean confident outlines with crisp smooth curves and consistent line weight, no wobble, no sketchy or rough lines, soft rounded shapes, flat color fills with one soft shade tone and one soft light tone, gentle subtle gradients allowed only inside shapes, simplified readable game shapes, not realistic, not photographic, muted warm gray-beige page tone like a page seen under a dim desk lamp, mid-key overall brightness (neither bright nor dark), a very subtle uniform paper texture and a very faint square grid, muted art-supply colors with low saturation, dark ink-gray outlines (not pure black), outline weight thick and consistent on gameplay objects, thinner on background, matte, flat lighting, calm melancholic mood with a quiet tension of adventure and combat, clear readable silhouettes, orthographic side view, quiet composition with breathing room, the unfinished theme is shown with clean dashed outlines and unfilled outline-only areas, never with messy strokes, high-resolution clean illustration (not pixel art), smooth anti-aliased edges, every wall and floor surface designed uniquely with no repeating pattern
blocks.UNIFY: UNIFIED LOOK: identical flat ambient light from the front for every asset, no directional light, no cast shadows, no glossy highlights, no rim light, only a soft faint contact shadow under grounded objects; every outline uses the same dark ink-gray, the same crisp clean stroke with rounded line caps, and the same line weight for the same layer; the same corner rounding on all shapes; shading is always one soft shade tone and one soft light tone inside each shape, the shade tone always on the lower-right side of a shape; surface patterns are clean parallel lines at 45 degrees (top-right to bottom-left) or clean simple motifs, never sketchy pencil hatching; the same very subtle paper texture over everything; same muted color temperature; looks like part of one continuous designed game; MID-KEY VALUES: the page paper sits around 70 percent brightness, far background slightly darker than the paper, middle background darker again, terrain mid-dark, outlines dark ink-gray, the protagonist is the lightest shape on screen, no large pure white areas, no crushed pure black areas, moderate contrast that keeps combat easy to read; GAME LOOK: stylized and simplified like game art, details grouped into big simple masses, shapes read at a glance, no realistic micro-detail, no painterly realism; CLEAN AND SMOOTH: crisp smooth outlines, soft rounded corners, no hard square tile edges, no repeated stamps or copy-pasted texture, pattern density and placement vary naturally across every surface

MAT.1: pencil-themed world: graphite-gray near-monochrome palette with warm grays, shapes inspired by pencils, erasers and graphite, clean diagonal stripe patterns that echo clean diagonal pencil-stripe pattern, small pinkish eraser-crumb dots, trees as simple clean pencil-line shapes
MAT.2: crayon-themed world: warm muted palette of orange, beige and dusty red with brown-tinted outlines, chunky rounded crayon-like shapes, clean wavy stripe motifs that echo crayon stripe motifs, smooth wax-drip blob shapes
MAT.3: watercolor-themed world: misty pale blue, gray-blue and dusty pink, soft smooth gradient washes inside clean shapes, round water-drop and ring motifs
MAT.4: colored-paper-themed world: flat single-color paper layers with one soft offset shadow, crisp fold lines, muted red, mustard yellow, sage green and slate blue
MAT.5: ink-themed world: deep black-violet smooth ink-blot silhouettes, clean ink drip shapes, small fragments of the earlier chapters' colors glowing softly through

TYPE.TERRAIN: large terrain fill texture sheet for the floors, ceilings and walls of an enclosed interior, square, flat front view, no perspective, no lighting direction, fills the whole image, NO visible repeating motif, pattern lines vary in density, length and placement everywhere, irregular organic variation like one big designed surface, big-mass variation is required: darker denser patches and lighter sparse patches, one or two faint strata lines, a few areas left half-filled with paper showing through, a few small embedded material bits (pebbles and crumbs of the drawing material), very subtle uniform paper texture (not canvas, not fabric weave), never one flat even gray, seamless tileable texture in all four directions: the left edge continues exactly into the right edge and the top edge continues exactly into the bottom edge, no border, no frame, no vignette, no edge darkening, all variations share the same outer border band so any variation can sit beside or above any other without a seam
TYPE.EDGE: long horizontal strip of a clean terrain edge on transparent background, very wide 4:1 strip, built in three zones: (1) a thick bold dark clean contour with an irregular rhythm of large bumps and small bends, a few chips, dents and one or two slight breaks, the contour rises and falls by about a quarter of the strip height, never a ruler line, never an even sine wave; (2) a dense darker surface band just inside the contour, about one fifth of the strip deep, with small details; (3) the interior beyond it gets lighter and sparser with a faint strata line and some half-filled paper showing; very subtle uniform paper texture (not canvas or fabric weave), same value and texture family as the matching floor or ceiling piece, soft anti-aliased edge, the left end continues exactly into the right end (same contour height, same band depth, same texture) so the strip repeats along any length without a seam
TYPE.TERRAIN_LINK: transition sheet of solid terrain fill between two neighboring zones of the same chapter, square, flat front view, same drawing material and value family on both sides, the first-zone side matches that zone's fill border band exactly, the second-zone side matches the other zone's fill border band exactly, the zone details change gradually in between, the two remaining edges continue into each other so it repeats along the whole boundary, very subtle uniform paper texture, no seam, no border
TYPE.CORNER: single organic rounded corner piece of terrain on transparent background, soft natural anti-aliased edge, smooth clean curve, matches a continuous edge strip
TYPE.PLATFORM: single long one-way platform plank on transparent background, side view, thick clean line on top, soft natural edges, organic clean shape, no two planks identical
TYPE.SPECIAL: single tall special terrain block on transparent background, side view, soft natural edges, designed as one unique object, not a repeating tile
TYPE.BG_WALL: back wall of an enclosed interior space inside the sketchbook world, seen flat and straight on, fills the whole frame edge to edge, NO sky, NO horizon, NO ground, NO outdoor landscape, no up or down direction, it is repeated sideways and stacked upward to fill wide halls and tall shafts, large soft value variation (a few darker hollows and lighter worn patches), very low contrast, 5-12% darker than the page paper, faint stripe pattern and a few faint drawn cracks or marks, far-distance layer so details are soft and sparse, no focal point, no objects, no repeating motif, square, seamless tileable texture in all four directions: the left edge continues exactly into the right edge and the top edge continues exactly into the bottom edge, no border, no frame, no vignette, no edge darkening, all variations of the same area share the same outer border band so any variation can sit beside or above any other without a seam
TYPE.BG_SET: single background set piece for an enclosed interior, isolated on transparent background, sits in the middle-distance layer behind the gameplay, simple readable silhouette, thin lines, low contrast, 15-20% darker than the page paper and lighter than the gameplay terrain, it will be placed in front of the back wall, so it must never look like it floats in the air: its ends are either cut off by the image edges or fade softly into the dark back wall, no flat horizontal tops that could look like walkable platforms (tops are rounded, slanted or ragged), soft natural anti-aliased edges, a few outline-only unfilled details
TYPE.BG_WALL_TALL: tall back wall for one very high interior room or shaft, one single continuous image, flat straight-on view, fills the frame edge to edge, NO sky, NO horizon, NO ground, the wall slowly changes from bottom to top to show progress while climbing, seamless on all four sides: the left edge continues exactly into the right edge, and the top and bottom border bands match the area's square back wall border band so it stacks above and below the square walls without a seam, very low contrast, 5-12% darker than the page paper, faint stripe pattern, no objects, no repeating motif
TYPE.BG_FORE: foreground frame piece of an enclosed interior on transparent background (hanging roots or rock lumps that frame the screen edge), dark soft silhouette, slightly faded, sparse, must not cover the middle of the screen, the left edge continues exactly into the right edge so it repeats sideways without a seam
TYPE.DECOR: decoration overlay for one room on a fully transparent background, the provided layout shows where terrain is, do NOT draw the terrain itself, do NOT fill walls, floors or air, everything except the decorations stays transparent, place a few unique small details hugging the terrain surfaces: cracks, faded outline-only marks, little clean scribble motifs, roots, vines, small landmark objects that give this room its own character, decorations sit on or just inside terrain edges, keep walkable air and every platform top completely clear, soft natural anti-aliased edges, sparse, no repeated motif, 16:9
TYPE.BG_WALL_LINK: transition sheet between the back walls of two neighboring interior areas, same rules as a back wall (no sky, no horizon, no objects, very low contrast), one side matches the first area's wall texture exactly and it gradually becomes the second area's wall texture toward the other side, the first-area side matches that area's wall border band exactly, the second-area side matches the other area's wall border band exactly, the two remaining edges continue into each other so the transition can be repeated along the whole boundary, no visible seam, same brightness, square
TYPE.PROP: single game prop, isolated on transparent background, centered, entire object visible, side view, same outline weight as gameplay objects
TYPE.CHAR: single 2D game sprite, side view facing right, full body visible, isolated on transparent background, simple readable silhouette, thick consistent outline, minimal interior detail, designed for smooth frame animation
TYPE.POSE: single animation key pose, side view facing right, full body, isolated on transparent background, body weight clearly readable, line of action is a smooth curve
TYPE.FX: clean 2D game effect, single frame, transparent background, no glow, no light, no bloom, made of drawing-material pieces
TYPE.UI: clean graphic game UI element looking like a small paper note or doodle on a sketchbook, semi-transparent cream paper slightly lighter than the page, clean rounded border, transparent background, no text
TYPE.KEY: illustration page from the same sketchbook, slightly more detailed than gameplay art but still stylized game art, same materials, outline, lighting and mid-key values, flat lighting, 16:9
